title: Elizondo was NRO liaison while at TTSA
summary: UAPGerb tells of Elizondo was NRO liaison while at TTSA, about 2017 at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Whilst he was at TTSA, uh Luellaando was liaison to the NRO.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that around 2017 Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, was working at the same time with To The Stars Academy, or TTSA, a private company that set out to study UFOs, and as a liaison to the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites. UAPGerb says this comes from Elizondo's own CV. If true, it would mean Elizondo kept an official intelligence role while he was working for a private UFO company.
